subject: Vulnerability management: evidence, implementation roadmap & SBOM attestation
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexuscloud.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@nexuscloud.com, procurement@nexuscloud.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Nexus RFP: detailed vulnerability management artifacts request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this RFP. Nexus is progressing through vendor security review and we need a detailed package for your vulnerability management program to clear the security gate for procurement. Specifically we need: 

- High-level SAST/DAST program description and cadence (tooling + ownership)
- Latest SAST executive summary (remediation rate, top 10 findings after triage)
- DAST executive summary and scope (external vs. internal scanning)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted findings OK) and remediation status
- SBOM for the platform (control plane and runtime images) and an attestation letter stating completeness and cutoff date
- Historical operational evidence showing patch SLA adherence for critical/important CVEs over the last 12 months
- Any standard runbooks for CVE triage and customer impact classification

We have to ingest artifacts into our procurement system by 2026-11-22. Can you confirm whether you can provide the deliverables and a short walkthrough call? I've attached a short RFP checklist (RFP_NX_Reqs_20261115.xlsx).

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement — Nexus security can be strict about SBOM completeness.

Best,
Asha Rao
Senior Security Program Manager
NexusCloud

[attachment: RFP_NX_Reqs_20261115.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexuscloud.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nexus RFP: detailed vulnerability management artifacts request

Hi Asha — thanks for the checklist and clear ask. We can deliver an evidence bundle and a 45–60 minute walkthrough before your procurement cut-off. Proposed plan/timeline: 

1) By 2026-11-18: preliminary executive summaries (SAST, DAST, pen test exec summary), SBOM export for control plane and runtime artifacts, and a draft SBOM attestation letter.
2) By 2026-11-20: supplemental operational records (patch SLA logs, remediation tickets), and redacted pen test report as needed.
3) 2026-11-19 or 2026-11-20: a 45-minute walkthrough. Please let us know available slots.

Quick clarifying Qs so we scope the artifacts correctly:
- Do you need SBOMs for every customer image derived from our platform, or only Redwood-managed control plane and runtime images?
- For patch SLA evidence, do you need a ticket-by-ticket audit trail or an aggregated CSV of incidents and durations?
- Is Nexus requesting proof of third-party dependency remediation (i.e., downstream library CVEs) or only Redwood-owned components?

I'll loop Sean (security) and Markus (product ops) here for technical artifacts and the runbook. We'll prepare the initial bundle and share a secure Drive link.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexuscloud.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@nexuscloud.com, procurement@nexuscloud.com
Date: 2026-11-16T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nexus RFP: detailed vulnerability management artifacts request

Stephanie — thanks, that timeline works for us. A few clarifications to make sure the artifacts meet legal/procurement requirements: 

- SBOM scope: control plane + runtime images + any sidecar/container images that are part of the shipped runtime. We do not need every customer build.
- Evidence format: tickets + aggregated CSV is preferred. Procurement may want a CSV import, while security will spot-check tickets.
- Third-party dependencies: yes, we need evidence that critical/high CVEs in third-party libraries are triaged and tracked to remediation (at minimum, a ticket ID and status).

One more ask: for the pen test summary, redacted PDFs are fine but please redact exploitable PII from logs. Also, we require an SBOM attestation letter signed by an officer (PDF) for procurement.

If you can confirm call times for 11/19 or 11/20 we will book.

Regards,
Asha

[Procurement note: Nexus needs artifacts by COB 2026-11-22 to hit Q4 onboarding]

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexuscloud.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Deliverables: Redwood VM exec summaries, SBOMs & attestation (initial bundle)

Asha — attaching the initial evidence bundle and providing a short summary below. Full drive folder linked for secure download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Redwood-NX-Evidence

Attachments included in this email (redacted where required):
- Redwood_SAST_ExecSumm_20261118.pdf (SAST program: quarterly scans via CodeScanX, ownership: AppSec team; overall remediation rate 92% for medium+ issues within 90 days; top remediated categories: cross-site scripting sanitized by input policies)
- Redwood_DAST_ExecSumm_20261118.pdf (DAST: monthly external scans + ad-hoc internal, coverage: public endpoints + internal admin portals; false-positive triage notes included)
- Redwood_PenTest_Summary_20261001_redacted.pdf (annual third-party pen test summary; critical findings from 2025 remediated and verified; report redacted to remove customer logs)
- Redwood_SBOM_ControlPlane_20261118.csv (SBOM: control plane + runtime base images; cutoff 2026-11-18)
- SBOM_Attestation_Redwood_20261118.pdf (attestation letter signed by our Head of Security)
- Patch_SLA_Operational_Record_202605-202611.csv (aggregated CSV of patch events and ticket IDs for P1/P2 classified CVEs)

Summary of key policies and commitments:
- SAST cadence: quarterly whole-repo scans, prioritized triage within 5 business days of discovery; remediation target: 90 days for medium, 30 days for high after triage acceptance.
- DAST cadence: scheduled monthly external scans; targeted internal scans for admin/console paths after major releases.
- Pen testing: annual full-scope test + ad-hoc engagements for major releases or critical vulnerability discoveries; remediation verification via follow-up scans.
- Patch SLAs (customer-facing): Critical (P1) security fixes — mitigation plan within 24 hours, targeted remediation and roll-out within 72 hours for infra-impacting issues; Customer-facing application critical fixes targeted within 7 calendar days depending on rollout and compatibility. For third-party library CVEs, we classify severity using CVSS and RFC-based mapping; high/critical libs are triaged immediately and tracked to remediation in our ticketing system.
- Triage runbook: ticket creation, customer impact classification, roll-forward/rollback playbooks, Canary release patterns for low-risk mitigations.

Notes about evidence and redactions: the pen test report has limited redactions to remove customer request traces and sample logs; SBOM CSV lists package name, version, checksum, and artifact path. If Nexus procurement needs a signed DocuSign attestation, we can route the SBOM_Attestation_Redwood_20261118.pdf through DocuSign for signature.

Next steps:
- We can do a 45-minute walkthrough on 2026-11-19 at 10:00 PT or 2026-11-20 at 11:00 PT. Please confirm.
- If you need additional ticket-level exports, Sean can produce a filtered export containing ticket IDs and remediation timestamps.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

[attachments: Redwood_SAST_ExecSumm_20261118.pdf (PDF), Redwood_DAST_ExecSumm_20261118.pdf (PDF), Redwood_PenTest_Summary_20261001_redacted.pdf (PDF), Redwood_SBOM_ControlPlane_20261118.csv (CSV), SBOM_Attestation_Redwood_20261118.pdf (PDF), Patch_SLA_Operational_Record_202605-202611.csv (CSV)]

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexuscloud.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@nexuscloud.com, procurement@nexuscloud.com
Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deliverables: Redwood VM exec summaries, SBOMs & attestation (initial bundle)

Stephanie — received, thank you. The bundle looks comprehensive and the cadence/policy summaries are helpful. A couple of quick items before procurement sign-off:

1) Could you please route the SBOM attestation via DocuSign to this mailbox and copy procurement@nexuscloud.com so we have a signed PDF on record?
2) Security-ops flagged one CSV row that appears to contain an internal host name that may be considered sensitive; can you remove or redact that single line in the SBOM CSV and re-upload?
3) We’d like a 30-minute follow-up call to walk through the patch SLA evidence and ticket IDs before we import the CSV into our system — 2026-11-20 at 11:00 PT works for us if you can re-run the export to exclude the host row.

Assuming the DocuSign attestation and redaction are in place, procurement will accept these artifacts for the Q4 onboarding path.

Thanks again — we appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Senior Security Program Manager
NexusCloud

[request: Please submit DocuSign to: procurement@nexuscloud.com and asharao@nexuscloud.com]
